chunks: Those to whom We have sent down the Book know this even as they know their sons. Yet a section among them conceals the truth knowingly.

key_terms.الْكِتَابَ: The Book (referring to the Torah and/or Gospel)

ai.seo_question: Why do some People of the Book know the truth but conceal it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the paradox of the People of the Book, particularly the Jews, who possessed the prophetic signs in their scriptures yet concealed them due to sectarian pride or political expediency. The comparison to recognizing one's own sons underscores the clarity and certainty of their knowledge, making their concealment a deliberate act of willful ignorance rather than uncertainty. This serves as a critique of those who claim divine authority but obscure the truth to maintain their status.
